cohort: The study included 58,629 women from an ongoing pregnancy cohort who were without thyroid dysfunction and hypertension at baseline.
finding: Women with dietary iodine intakes lower than 100 mg/day had a significantly higher risk of new-onset hypertension up to 10 years after delivery compared to those with iodine intakes in the recommended range.
followup_time: median 7.1 years (up to 10 years after delivery)
